cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows mouse input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: esq.17 settled the KEYBOARD Ctrl+V BeforeDropOrPaste veto (Cancel=True suppresses the paste) and OxForms honors it via a two-stage paste; the DRAG-DROP origin still inserts synchronously (veto recorded-not-honored). oxforms-4f8 asks: does a vetoing BeforeDropOrPaste (Cancel=True) suppress a DRAG-DROP drop the same way a keyboard paste?

SourceBox holds 'OxFormsDragSeed' and has DragBehavior enabled at RUNTIME (UserForm_Initialize) so its selected text can be dragged; TargetBox is the drop target. TargetBox_BeforeDropOrPaste uses the plain-TextBox MdcTextEvents signature (Cancel, Action, Data, X, Y, Effect, Shift -- NO leading Index), matching the committed paste-veto + ctrlv-keyboard-ordering fixtures. When gVetoDrop is armed it sets Cancel.Value = True.

Two scenarios: dragdrop_baseline (gVetoDrop False) should drop the text into TargetBox (Change fires); dragdrop_veto (gVetoDrop True) is the load-bearing case -- the rows reveal whether a vetoing BeforeDropOrPaste suppresses the drop (no Change, TargetBox unchanged) AND the Action value for a drag-drop (vs Action=2 for a keyboard paste).

No control fonts are declared/applied (a design-time font set hangs the SaveAs dialog). value_after is TargetBox.Value at handler entry, so a suppressed drop shows the value unchanged across the BeforeDropOrPaste row; the notes column carries the Action/Effect/Shift/Data details.
